text:
alice_ae: Heads-up: SummitBank POC next Tue 10:00-15:00 PST. They want a live burst demo of chat with tight tail latency. Can infra provision an ephemeral dedicated pool and prewarm? target steady 6 GPUs, burst to 12 for short periods.
ben_se: Need to decide soft-escrow vs short-term commit. Also need scoped API keys and IP allowlist. Customer prefers no hard commit.
carlos_infra: We can spin `summit-poc-warm`. Soft-escrow flow: reserve credits, cap usage; if exhausted we can auto-fallback to a smaller model or throttle. Requires AE approval for escrow amount.
alice_ae: I can approve up to $1.8k escrow. They need guaranteed no cold starts for a 45m prewarm window.
dia_runtime: We will run prewarm jobs that prime KV cache and keep workers hot. Need model + seq len + peak qps. Also add route tag `route=summit-poc`.
ben_se: Model: `redwood-13b-v2-q4`, seq_len 1024, peak qps 100 sustained, spikes to 160.
dia_runtime: Suggested autoscale snippet (apply as config):
```
min_gpus: 6
max_gpus: 12
scale_up_qps: 90
cooldown_s: 120
burst_bucket: summit-demo-credits
prewarm: true
graceful_drain_s: 300
```
carlos_infra: We'll provision pool with prewarm job 60m before start and a smoke test 2h before. Need CIDRs for IP allowlist (send in DM).
emma_csm: Security note: SummitBank wants KMS restricted to pool SA and audit logs for 180 days for the POC. For this run they accept hosted dedicated + IP allowlist.
alice_ae: Sending CIDRs now: 52.23.45.0/24 and 18.204.56.128/26.
carlos_infra: Creating scoped AE key `summit-demo-ae` valid 12h and customer key `summit-demo-cust` valid 8h. Keys will be stored in vault and shared via secure channel.
ben_se: If escrow depletes mid-demo, confirm behavior: auto-fallback to `redwood-7b-v2-q4` + throttle, no auto-billing?
carlos_infra: Correct — soft-escrow caps consumption. On depletion we will switch to fallback model and throttle; we will not bill beyond escrow without explicit approval.
alice_ae: Approve fallback to `redwood-7b-v2-q4`. Add conversion path in runbook if they want to upgrade to hard-reserve mid-demo.
dia_runtime: Will add route-based model pin and prewarm job. We'll run synthetic load during smoke tests and post latency traces to the console.
provision-bot: pool `summit-poc-warm` scheduled for provisioning 2025-11-11T17:00:00Z; infra will update status here. :white_check_mark:
ben_se: Thanks all — I'll update SummitBank with the plan and escrow amount.
